QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: mqttHost
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Host name to mqtt server. i.e: localhost:1883

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: serverToken
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Your personal access token for server

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: appId
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: App created in dji. Used in server

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: appKey
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: App created in dji. Used in server

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: appLicense
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: App created in dji. Used in server

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: nativeCloudConnect
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Connect to cloud MQTT natively using mqttHost/user/password instead of waiting for web SDK trigger

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: coordinateTransform
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Only for backends that store shapes in GCJ-02 (AMap/Gaode coordinates). Turns it on converts incoming shapes to WGS84 and outgoing ones back to GCJ-02. Our backend stores plain WGS84, so this stays off; turning it on shifts every shape by 300-600m.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: drcInvertX
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Flip the sign of the x axis of drone_control (left/right). The Cloud API docs and some backends disagree about which way x>0 moves the aircraft; flip this if it goes right when the joystick is pushed left.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: drcInvertY
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Flip the sign of the y axis of drone_control (forward/back). Same reasoning as drcInvertX: only a bench test settles the direction.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: drcInvertW
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Flip the sign of the w axis of drone_control (yaw rate, clockwise positive).

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: drcCameraHFov
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Horizontal field of view of the camera, used to convert the normalized screen coordinates of camera_aim into gimbal angles. QGC cannot read lens FOV from the camera, so set this per lens (wide angle, zoom and IR all differ).

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: drcRequireLocalConsent
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: When on, a cloud control request (cloud_control_auth_request or the two *_authority_grab calls) pops a dialog on this ground station and drone_control is refused with 327002 until the operator agrees. On by default: handing the sticks to somebody else's web panel is exactly the moment a local operator should get a say. Turn it off for unattended operation, where nobody is at the ground station to answer the dialog.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: drcEmergencyStopEnabled
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Allow a cloud drone_emergency_stop through to the aircraft. It maps to MAV_CMD_DO_FLIGHTTERMINATION, which stops the motors in flight and cannot be undone. Even with this on, the operator still has to confirm every request in the dialog.
